channel.title: Japan AI Monitor
channel.description: AI monitoring of Japan's political, economic and security developments

item.title: Japan team creates ‘planimal’ hybrid plant-animal cells in world first
item.description: Cells that produce useful animal and plant proteins and can be cultured using photosynthesis could offer new methods of producing drugs and meat.

item.title: Japan yet to make full use of nuclear power equipment export treaty with India
item.description: New Delhi has a goal of boosting India's nuclear power capacity to 100 gigawatts by 2047, and reducing greenhouse gas emissions to net zero by 2070.

item.title: Sumitomo Mitsui, Mizuho raises annual profit forecast and announces share buyback
item.description: Japanese lenders are on a record earnings streak thanks to the BOJ's interest-rate hikes, with corporate borrowing showing few signs of slowing down.

item.title: Oh and Kuriyama call for change as Japan’s baseball landscape shifts
item.description: The two baseball legends are seeking to inspire Japan's next generation of players as many seek their fortunes in MLB.

item.title: Swiss franc, Japanese yen Rise as DeepSeek News Boosts Safe Havens
item.description: The Yen and Swiss Franc were stronger against the dollar as investors sought safe havens after Chinese start-up DeepSeek’s new AI model hit U.S. tech stocks.
